en: Abstract
zh: 摘要

en: This article examines Ibn Khaldûn not as a stable, timeless precursor of modern social science but as a figure constituted through colonial translation and reception. Focusing on nineteenth- and twentieth-century French and English translations of the

, it argues that Ibn Khaldûn emerged in modern scholarship as a colonial archive—a site where translation, race, and epistemic authority intersected to produce new forms of historical and sociological knowledge. Through close comparison of Arabic originals and their European translations, the article shows how colonial epistemologies reconfigured Ibn Khaldûn’s analytical categories—particularly those concerning tribe, generation, civilization, and climate—into racialized frameworks foreign to his medieval context. It further demonstrates how this translated Ibn Khaldûn became selectively relevant to European social science while remaining excluded from its canonical genealogies. Finally, the article critically reassesses the enduring claim that Ibn Khaldûn articulated racist views about Black populations, showing that this attribution itself belongs to the colonial archive generated through translation rather than to the epistemic logic of the original text. The article thus contributes to comparative histories of knowledge, colonial epistemology, and the global formation of the social sciences.
zh: 本文不把伊本·赫勒敦视为现代社会科学一个稳定、超越时代的先驱，而将他视为经由殖民翻译与接受过程建构起来的人物。文章聚焦于19世纪和20世纪《历史绪论》（Muqaddimah）的法译本和英译本，认为伊本·赫勒敦在现代学术中以一种殖民档案的形态出现：在这一场域，翻译、种族和知识权威相互交织，生产出新的历史与社会学知识形式。通过细致比较阿拉伯语原文及其欧洲语言译本，本文揭示，殖民知识论如何把伊本·赫勒敦的分析范畴——尤其是部落、世代、文明与气候等范畴——重新配置成与其中世纪语境格格不入的种族化框架。文章进而说明，经过翻译的伊本·赫勒敦如何在欧洲社会科学中获得选择性的关联地位，却依然被排除在其经典谱系之外。最后，本文批判性地重新考察一种经久不衰的说法，即伊本·赫勒敦对黑人群体表达过种族主义观点，并指出，这种归责本身属于翻译所生成的殖民档案，而非原文的知识逻辑。因此，本文旨在为知识的比较史、殖民知识论及社会科学在全球的形成史作出贡献。

en: Among Muslim thinkers of the medieval era, Ibn Khaldûn occupies a distinct place not only in the medieval genealogy of historical knowledge but also in the modern one. In the context of the colonization of Algeria, Ibn Khaldûn emerged as a major thinker—first in French, through the translation of William McGuckin de Slane, and later in English, through the translation of Franz Rosenthal, which follows the French text.

It is through these translations and their reception that Ibn Khaldûn came to be constituted as a major historical and sociological figure in modern European scholarship. His importance has been such that he is one of the very few medieval figures, if not the only one, who has relevance to the modern social sciences, especially at the time of their emergence in the nineteenth century.

He garners recognition and respect and appears among the few thinkers from outside the Western tradition who are regularly quoted in the halls of academe. Moreover, he may be the only non-Western thinker to be placed alongside Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel, Karl Marx, and Max Weber.

Yet, paradoxically, this intriguing figure is also largely erased from the history of European thought even as he is sometimes compared to its iconic figures. He is absent from its genealogy even when his concepts resonate with the modern, foregrounding some of the perspectives and even theories of modern sociology.

This article approaches the constitution of that relevance and authority, considering it not as a neutral process of transmission but as a colonial one, and asking how Ibn Khaldûn was transformed from a medieval author to a modern one who is himself a colonial archive.
zh: 在中世纪穆斯林思想家中，伊本·赫勒敦不仅在中世纪历史知识的谱系中占有独特位置，在现代谱系中也同样如此。在阿尔及利亚被殖民的背景下，伊本·赫勒敦作为一位重要思想家进入视野：首先经由威廉·麦格金·德·斯兰的翻译进入法语世界，随后经由弗朗茨·罗森塔尔沿循法译本的翻译进入英语世界。
正是通过这些翻译及其接受过程，伊本·赫勒敦才在现代欧洲学术中被建构为历史学与社会学的重要人物。他的重要性如此突出，以至于在对现代社会科学——尤其是它们在19世纪兴起时的社会科学——具有关联意义的中世纪人物中，即便他不是唯一的一位，也属于极少数。
他获得认可与尊重，是少数在学术殿堂中经常被引用的非西方传统思想家之一。此外，他或许也是唯一被与格奥尔格·威廉·弗里德里希·黑格尔、卡尔·马克思和马克斯·韦伯并列的非西方思想家。
然而，矛盾的是，尽管人们有时将这一引人入胜的人物与欧洲思想的标志性人物相比，他却也在很大程度上被抹去了在欧洲思想史中的位置。即使他的概念与现代思想发生共鸣，预示了现代社会学的某些视角乃至理论，他依然缺席于欧洲思想的谱系。
本文考察这种关联地位与权威的建构，不把它视为中性的传递过程，而视为殖民过程，并追问：伊本·赫勒敦如何从一位中世纪作者转变为一位现代作者，乃至他自身就成为一份殖民档案？

en: Ibn Khaldûn is the author of a considerable historiographic work called the
, in three volumes, not all of which have gained the same attention.
The first volume is the

, the text for which he is best known; it earned him a special place among world historians. The second volume is a history of the Berbers that, as translated by William de Slane in the mid-nineteenth century, serves as a foundational text on the history of the Maghreb—a major historiographic reference with a distinct discursive trajectory. Colonial historians relied on this volume not only to create a French historiography of the Maghreb but also to invent a new conception of the region.
The third volume of Ibn Khaldûn’s
, which deals with the history of Islam and of Muslim dynasties in the East (
), was composed after his move to Egypt in 1382. By the turn of the twentieth century, scholars such as Reynold Alleyne Nicholson considered this volume less innovative than the
, noting that Ibn Khaldûn’s method is applied less systematically here. This view, repeated by Taha Hussein in 1918 and by others, reinforced the perception that the
is largely detached from the more traditional historiographic content of the third volume and even the second volume.
Consequently, in Western academia, it has received comparatively little attention and has not been translated into English. Its neglect is particularly striking compared to both the
and the second volume, which, as noted earlier, was foundational for French colonial scholars of the Maghreb and, subsequently, North African national historians.
zh: 伊本·赫勒敦著有一部规模可观的史学著作《鉴戒之书》（Kitâb al-ʿIbar），分为三卷，各卷受到的关注并不相同。
第一卷是《历史绪论》，也是他最广为人知的文本，使他在世界历史学家中赢得了特殊地位。第二卷是柏柏尔人的历史，威廉·德·斯兰在19世纪中叶将其译出之后，它成为马格里布历史的奠基性文本：一部具有独特话语轨迹的重要史学参考文献。殖民历史学家依赖这一卷，不仅建立了关于马格里布的法国史学，也发明了一种关于该地区的新观念。
《鉴戒之书》第三卷讨论伊斯兰教的历史及东方（Mashriq）穆斯林王朝的历史，写于他1382年迁往埃及之后。到20世纪之交，雷诺德·阿莱恩·尼科尔森等学者认为，这一卷不及《历史绪论》富有创新性，并指出伊本·赫勒敦在此并未那么系统地运用自己的方法。塔哈·侯赛因于1918年以及其他学者后来反复申说这一观点，强化了一种看法：即《历史绪论》在很大程度上与第三卷、甚至第二卷较为传统的史学内容相互脱离。
因此，在西方学界，第三卷受到的关注相对较少，也尚未被译成英语。与《历史绪论》和第二卷相比，它受到的忽视尤其明显；如前所述，第二卷对于研究马格里布的法国殖民学者以及此后的北非民族历史学家而言，都具有奠基意义。

en: In this article, I propose to interrogate Ibn Khaldûn as a colonial archive—a site where knowledge about a medieval author is produced, transformed, and regulated through translation, reception, and disciplinary frameworks shaped by colonial and European epistemes. The colonial archive highlights not only the multiple authorial figures associated with Ibn Khaldûn but also the processes through which these figures are conflated, racialized, or erased.
zh: 本文拟将伊本·赫勒敦作为一份殖民档案加以探究：在这一场域，关于一位中世纪作者的知识，经过受殖民及欧洲知识型塑造的翻译、接受与学科框架，被生产、转化并受到规制。殖民档案既凸显与伊本·赫勒敦相关的多重作者形象，也凸显这些形象被混同、种族化或抹除的过程。

en: My inquiry follows four intertwined threads: first, the translation of Ibn Khaldûn’s

and the conditions that produced Ibn Khaldûn as a colonial author; second, the ways in which this colonial author gained relevance and authority within European knowledge systems; third, how his text and ideas have been racialized and reframed through colonial interpretive practices; and finally, how, despite his recognition in Orientalist scholarship as an outstanding personality and even a genius, Ibn Khaldûn has often been excluded from histories of European sociological theory. Addressing these questions requires not only recovering the medieval author but also engaging in an epistemic decolonization—interrogating the assumptions, structures, and practices that have governed what counts as knowledge of him and about him. First, however, let me outline the intellectual context and multiple receptions of Ibn Khaldûn in order to situate the argument of this article, which focuses on the transformation of his thought through translation within a colonial epistemic framework.
zh: 我的探究沿着四条相互交织的线索展开：第一，《历史绪论》的翻译，以及将伊本·赫勒敦生产为殖民作者的条件；第二，这位殖民作者在欧洲知识体系中获得关联地位和权威的方式；第三，他的文本与思想如何经由殖民阐释实践被种族化并重新框定；最后，尽管东方学承认伊本·赫勒敦是一位杰出人物，甚至是天才，他却往往仍被排除在欧洲社会学理论史之外。回答这些问题，不仅需要重新发现那位中世纪作者，也需要开展知识上的去殖民化：质问那些支配着何种东西算作他的知识、以及关于他的知识的假设、结构与实践。不过，首先让我勾勒伊本·赫勒敦的思想背景及其多重接受史，以定位本文的论点：在殖民知识框架之中，他的思想如何通过翻译发生转变。

en: Before and Beyond the Colonial Archive
zh: 殖民档案之前与之外

en: Ibn Khaldûn’s work must be situated within the intellectual and political milieu of the fourteenth-century Islamic West, particularly the Maghreb and al-Andalus, regions marked by both vibrant scholarly activity and acute political instability. Dynastic rivalries, shifting allegiances, and the far-reaching consequences of the Black Death created a world in which the fragility of power and the transformation of societies were constantly on display. These conditions were not merely background to Ibn Khaldûn’s thought but constituted the very material from which his historical analysis emerged. Several studies have examined this context, especially the work of Muhsin Mahdi, who situates Ibn Khaldûn in relation to Greek thought,
and Abdessalem Cheddadi, who investigates both Ibn Khaldûn and his time as well as his modern receptions.
Given the scope of this study—examining the emergence of Ibn Khaldûn as a colonial archive—I outline some important instances of reception, including those often neglected.
zh: 伊本·赫勒敦的著作必须被置于14世纪伊斯兰西部的思想和政治环境中理解，尤其是马格里布与安达卢斯；这两个地区既有活跃的学术活动，也有剧烈的政治动荡。王朝间的竞争、不断变换的效忠关系以及黑死病的深远影响，构成了一个权力的脆弱性与社会转型不断显露的世界。这些条件并非只是伊本·赫勒敦思想的背景，而正是其历史分析由以产生的材料。已有若干研究考察这一语境，尤以穆赫辛·马赫迪将伊本·赫勒敦置于与希腊思想的关系中加以讨论的著作，
以及阿卜杜萨拉姆·舍达迪关于伊本·赫勒敦及其时代和现代接受史的研究为代表。
鉴于本研究着眼于伊本·赫勒敦作为殖民档案的形成，我将概述若干重要的接受实例，包括那些经常遭到忽视的实例。

en: Intellectually, Ibn Khaldûn was formed within a well-established tradition that organized knowledge into the “traditional sciences” and the “rational sciences.” His education reflects this dual structure.

What distinguishes him is the way he mobilized it. His exposure to philosophical thought—particularly through al-Abili and engagement with Avicenna, al-Razi, and Ibn Rushd—left a clear imprint on his analytical method, while his grounding in the religious sciences anchored his work within the broader Islamic scholarly tradition.

This formation was inseparable from political experience. Ibn Khaldûn’s career—across Tunis, Fez, Granada, and Cairo—placed him in direct contact with rulers, jurists, and scholars, exposing him to the instability of dynasties and the role of social solidarities in sustaining authority.
zh: 在思想上，伊本·赫勒敦成长于一个成熟的传统之中，该传统将知识组织为“传承诸科学”与“理性诸科学”。他的教育反映了这一双重结构。
使他与众不同的是他运用这一结构的方式。他对哲学思想的接触——尤其通过阿比利，以及与伊本·西那、拉齐和伊本·鲁世德思想的交流——在其分析方法中留下了明显印记；与此同时，他在宗教诸科学方面的根基，使其著作扎根于更广泛的伊斯兰学术传统。
这一思想养成过程与政治经历密不可分。伊本·赫勒敦辗转突尼斯、非斯、格拉纳达与开罗的生涯，使他直接接触统治者、法学家和学者，亲历王朝的不稳定性，以及社会团结在维系权威方面的作用。

en: The historiographical tradition he inherited relied heavily on transmission. Historians such as al-Tabari and al-Masʿudi compiled extensive chronicles but did not systematically interrogate the conditions that made historical events possible. Of these two historians, Ibn Khaldûn considers al-Tabari “the historian of the umma” (

). Meanwhile, Masʿudi (d. 956) is the author of a major book from which Ibn Khaldûn is likely to have drawn most of his material on human diversity and even his theory of climatic effects on humans, which Masʿudi himself borrowed from Galen. Yet Ibn Khaldûn vigorously critiqued Masʿudi’s views, especially in regard to Black populations, as I will show below. In his introduction, Ibn Khaldûn notes that his enterprise resembles those of Tabari and Masʿudi, consisting mainly in recording a moment of great historical change.
zh: 他继承的史学传统高度依赖传述。塔巴里和马苏第等历史学家编纂了浩繁的编年史，却未系统追问使历史事件成为可能的条件。在这两位历史学家中，伊本·赫勒敦将塔巴里称为“乌玛的历史学家”（mu’arrikh al-umma）。马苏第（卒于956年）则著有一部重要著作，伊本·赫勒敦关于人类多样性的大部分材料，甚至关于气候对人的影响的理论，很可能都取自该书，而马苏第本人又从盖伦那里借用了这种理论。然而，伊本·赫勒敦严厉批评了马苏第的观点，尤其是他对黑人群体的看法，下文将予以说明。伊本·赫勒敦在导言中指出，自己的事业类似于塔巴里和马苏第的事业，主要在于记录一个发生重大历史变迁的时刻。

zh: 伊本·赫勒敦的其他思想来源包括他的密友伊本·哈提卜；后者撰写了格拉纳达史，其中可以看到ʿaṣabiyya这一概念。伊本·赫勒敦将这一概念融入自己对部落如何成为国家的解释。另一个来源是他较年轻的对手伊本·里德万，后者同样是一位来自突尼斯的安达卢斯人，著有一部关于宫廷与政治的重要著作，成为伊本·赫勒敦的一项重要资料来源。
不过，尽管存在这些范本——或者更确切地说，正因为有这些范本——伊本·赫勒敦在《历史绪论》中的创新，尤其是对umrân（常被译作“文化”或“文明”）及ʿaṣabiyya（部落团结）的分析，引入了以国家（dawla）的形成为中心的批判性与解释性维度，力图揭示支配人类社会的深层原则。

en: Ibn Khaldûn’s work has been read differently across historical contexts. Early on, some of his contemporaries recognized the

as a new contribution. As a historian, he was highly regarded, and his work circulated through teaching and scholarly exchange. Figures such as al-Maqrizi and Ibn al-Azraq engaged with his concepts and extended aspects of his method. His historiography maintained a strong presence in Maghrebi intellectual traditions for centuries.
zh: 在不同的历史语境中，人们对伊本·赫勒敦的著作作出了不同解读。早期，他的一些同时代人就将《历史绪论》视为一项新的贡献。作为历史学家，他备受推崇，其著作通过教学与学术交流传播。马格里齐和伊本·艾兹拉克等人探讨他的概念，并发展了他方法中的某些方面。几个世纪以来，他的史学一直在马格里布思想传统中占有重要地位。

However, ideas similar to those developed by Ibn Khaldûn in the

but also used its ideas in their writings on the Ottoman Empire.
However, the
also had influence beyond academic circles, becoming important in the formation of the politicians, diplomats, intellectuals, and bureaucrats of the Empire.
zh: 到16世纪末，伊本·赫勒敦的著作已传入奥斯曼帝国的腹地。1598年，奥斯曼学者兼诗人韦伊西·埃芬迪在开罗得到一部《历史绪论》手稿。

不过，在16世纪奥斯曼重要知识分子穆斯塔法·阿里的著作中，已经出现了与伊本·赫勒敦在《历史绪论》中提出的思想相似的观点。尽管整个16世纪都有《历史绪论》的抄本在奥斯曼帝国流传，但到了17世纪，帝国的历史学家才开始公开讨论、扩展和借用伊本·赫勒敦，尤其是那些关注王朝权力衰落与国家治理的史家。卡蒂布·切莱比（哈吉·哈里发，卒于1657年）与穆斯塔法·纳伊马（卒于1716年）是较早的代表；他们不仅阅读并了解《历史绪论》，还在关于奥斯曼帝国的著作中运用了其中的思想。
然而，《历史绪论》的影响也超越了学术圈，对帝国政治家、外交官、知识分子及官僚的养成具有重要作用。

en: Europe knew of Ibn Khaldûn at least as early as the sixteenth century, through another important text, written in Latin by a Moroccan diplomat and convert, Hassan al-Wazzan. He wrote
in 1550, translated into French in 1555 and into English in 1600.
Ibn Khaldûn is cited throughout the book. A copy of the
existed in seventeenth-century Leiden.
Meanwhile, Thomas Hobbes’s treatise on the necessity (and naturalness) of the state is reminiscent of the same discussion found in the

Is this a coincidence? Perhaps—but the parallel is striking. Even if it is a coincidence, a historian of ideas would necessarily have explored the connections between thinkers examining something as important as the state—not necessarily to suggest that one borrowed from the other, but to highlight the political and philosophical conditions that made such reflection possible.
zh: 欧洲至少早在16世纪就已通过另一部重要文本了解伊本·赫勒敦，该书由摩洛哥外交官、改宗者哈桑·瓦赞以拉丁文写成。他在1550年撰写了《非洲描述》，该书于1555年译成法语，1600年译成英语。
书中多处引述伊本·赫勒敦。17世纪的莱顿已有一部《历史绪论》抄本。
与此同时，托马斯·霍布斯关于国家之必要性与自然性的论说，让人联想到《历史绪论》中同样的讨论。这是巧合吗？也许是——但二者的相似性令人瞩目。即使是巧合，思想史家也理应探究那些讨论国家这样重要问题的思想家之间的联系；这样做未必是为了说明一方向另一方借鉴，而是为了凸显使这种思考成为可能的政治与哲学条件。

en: Be that as it may, in modern contexts, Ibn Khaldûn continued to be read through mediation. Engagements during the Arab renaissance of the twentieth century, such as that of Taha Hussein, relied heavily on the French translation of de Slane, treating it as a substitute for the Arabic text rather than as a colonial artifact in its own right. In the context of colonial domination, interest in Ibn Khaldûn also reflected a broader ideological need to mobilize major intellectual figures in response to Western cultural dominance.

Across these diverse contexts, a common pattern emerges: Ibn Khaldûn’s work is rarely encountered on its own terms but is mediated through translations, ideological frameworks, and scholarly traditions that reshape its meaning for each audience. His reception extended beyond the Arab world: in Iran, for example, Ali Shariati read Ibn Khaldûn as a philosopher of history through categories influenced by European thought. In his reading, one encounters Émile Durkheim in Ibn Khaldûn more than Ibn Khaldûn in Durkheim. In other words, rather than searching for Ibn Khaldûn’s ideas in Durkheim, or arguing—as is often done—that Durkheim borrowed from the medieval historian, Shariati points out that Ibn Khaldûn, as a Muslim thinker, had already rethought the craft of history long before similar reflections emerged in the age of modernity. However, Shariati’s broader political concerns aligned more closely with the anticolonial immediacy of thinkers such as Frantz Fanon, while his engagement with Ibn Khaldûn centered primarily on questions of history, social change, and the rise and decline of civilizations.
zh: 无论如何，在现代语境中，人们仍然通过各种中介来阅读伊本·赫勒敦。在20世纪阿拉伯复兴运动期间，对他的研究——如塔哈·侯赛因的研究——高度依赖德·斯兰的法译本，将其当作阿拉伯语文本的替代品，而非具有独立研究价值的殖民产物。在殖民统治背景下，人们对伊本·赫勒敦的兴趣，也反映了一种更广泛的意识形态需求：借助重要思想人物来回应西方文化支配。

在这些不同语境中，一种共同模式浮现出来：人们很少依照伊本·赫勒敦著作自身的条件来接触它，而是通过翻译、意识形态框架与学术传统的中介；这些中介为每一类读者重新塑造其意义。他的接受史也超出阿拉伯世界：例如在伊朗，阿里·沙里亚蒂通过受欧洲思想影响的范畴，将伊本·赫勒敦读作历史哲学家。在他的解读中，人们更多地是在伊本·赫勒敦身上遇见埃米尔·涂尔干，而非在涂尔干身上遇见伊本·赫勒敦。换言之，沙里亚蒂不是在涂尔干那里寻找伊本·赫勒敦的思想，也不是像常见论述那样主张涂尔干借用了这位中世纪史家的思想，而是指出：作为穆斯林思想家的伊本·赫勒敦，早在现代性时代出现类似反思之前，就已经重新思考了历史书写的技艺。然而，沙里亚蒂更广泛的政治关切，与弗朗茨·法农等思想家的迫切反殖民诉求更为接近；而他对伊本·赫勒敦的探讨，则主要集中于历史、社会变迁以及文明兴衰等问题。

en: Despite Ibn Khaldûn’s wide reception across disciplines and cultures, he has rarely been interrogated through a decolonial or postcolonial lens. Major figures of early decolonizing thought, such as Abdallah Laroui, Abdelkebir Khatibi, and Mohammed Abid al-Jabri, engage seriously with his work, yet they mobilize him primarily as a resource for rethinking modernity in the Arab context rather than making him the object of the kind of critique I propose here—one that interrogates the colonial/postcolonial constructions of Ibn Khaldûn we inherited, including the role of translation, Orientalist mediation, and editorial transmission.

Mohamed Arkoun argues that the interest in Ibn Khaldûn is due, of course, to “the theoretical scope of the Muqaddima,” but also “the need of contemporary ideology to rely on major figures of the past in order to resist the ‘cultural aggression’ of the West.”
zh: 尽管伊本·赫勒敦在不同学科和文化中得到广泛接受，却很少有人从去殖民或后殖民视角对其进行追问。早期去殖民思想的重要人物，如阿卜杜拉·拉鲁伊、阿卜杜勒凯比尔·哈提比和穆罕默德·阿比德·贾卜里，都认真探讨他的著作；但他们主要将他作为重新思考阿拉伯语境中现代性的资源，而没有将他作为本文所提出的那种批判的对象——即质问我们所继承的伊本·赫勒敦之殖民／后殖民建构，包括翻译、东方学中介和编辑传承的作用。
穆罕默德·阿尔昆认为，人们之所以对伊本·赫勒敦感兴趣，固然是由于“《历史绪论》的理论广度”，也是由于“当代意识形态需要依靠过去的重要人物，以抵抗西方的‘文化侵略’”。

en: Likewise, within postcolonial studies—most prominently associated with Edward Said—Ibn Khaldûn appears often as a name, but only marginally. Beyond a few passing references to
and one reference to secularism,

Said does not engage either the medieval author or the afterlives of his work in colonial knowledge systems, including in Orientalist scholarship, where Ibn Khaldûn was effectively reconstituted as an object of European knowledge.
zh: 同样，在以爱德华·萨义德最具代表性的后殖民研究中，伊本·赫勒敦时常作为一个名字出现，却只处于边缘位置。除几次顺带提及ʿaṣabiyya，以及一次谈到世俗主义之外，
萨义德既未深入探讨这位中世纪作者，也未考察其著作在殖民知识体系中的后续生命，包括在东方学中的后续生命——在那里，伊本·赫勒敦事实上被重新建构为欧洲知识的对象。

en: This absence is striking, especially given Said’s own admission of a long-standing intellectual interest in Ibn Khaldûn: “For at least thirty years,” he remarked in an interview, “I’ve been planning a seminar on Vico and Ibn Khaldûn, the great fourteenth-century historiographer and philosopher of history. But my sense of identity as a teacher of Western literature has excluded this other aspect of my activity so far as the classroom is concerned.”
Such a stance presumes a stable division between “Western” and “Arabic” intellectual traditions. Yet this boundary becomes less tenable when one considers that Ibn Khaldûn’s
entered modern intellectual history through its nineteenth-century French translation—a foundational textual moment in the formation of French Orientalism.
Had Said encountered Ibn Khaldûn within this Orientalist archive, the terms of disciplinary belonging—and thus of engagement—might have appeared differently.
zh: 这种缺席令人瞩目，尤其是萨义德本人曾承认，自己长期以来一直对伊本·赫勒敦抱有思想上的兴趣。他在一次访谈中说：“至少三十年来，我一直打算开设一门关于维柯和伊本·赫勒敦的研讨课，后者是14世纪伟大的史学家和历史哲学家。但就课堂而言，我作为西方文学教师的身份感，一直把我活动的另一面排除在外。”
这种立场预设“西方”与“阿拉伯”思想传统之间存在稳定的区分。然而，如果考虑到伊本·赫勒敦的《历史绪论》是通过19世纪法译本进入现代思想史的——这是法国东方学形成过程中的一个奠基性文本时刻——这一边界便不那么站得住脚。
倘若萨义德是在这份东方学档案中接触伊本·赫勒敦，那么学科归属的条件、因而也是展开研究的条件，或许就会呈现不同面貌。

en: Several factors explain Ibn Khaldûn’s noticeable absence from decolonial and postcolonial critique, linked to the historical trajectory through which his work entered modern scholarship. One concerns the problem of translation. Since Walter Benjamin, translation has been recognized as a central theoretical concern within literary studies, yet few postcolonial scholars have foregrounded it as a site of colonial and postcolonial intervention.

Translation studies have often developed on a parallel track to postcolonial scholarship, despite their shared investments. Only more recently have postcolonial and decolonial approaches begun to examine translation systematically as a site of epistemic transformation.

The translation of historiography in particular has remained under-theorized, especially during the consolidation of postcolonial studies in the 1990s, as scholars of Ibn Khaldûn frequently treated his translation as transparent rather than as a site of conceptual reconfiguration.
zh: 有若干因素可以解释伊本·赫勒敦在去殖民与后殖民批判中的明显缺席，这些因素与其著作进入现代学术的历史轨迹有关。其中之一是翻译问题。自瓦尔特·本雅明以来，翻译已被视为文学研究中的一个核心理论问题，但很少有后殖民学者将其突出为殖民与后殖民干预的场域。
尽管翻译研究与后殖民学术具有共同关切，二者却往往沿着平行轨道发展。直到较近时期，后殖民与去殖民研究路径才开始系统考察翻译这一知识转化的场域。
尤其是史学翻译，始终缺乏充分的理论化，特别是在后殖民研究于20世纪90年代巩固发展的时期；研究伊本·赫勒敦的学者常常将其翻译视为透明的传递，而非概念重新配置的场所。

en: A related factor is that postcolonial studies, shaped in large part by Said’s
, have concentrated on Arabic literary studies but much less on Arabic historiography, which remains more closely aligned with the intellectual field that Said’s critique originally targeted.

Translation was not then seen as a site of postcolonial investigation. Even the translation of Frantz Fanon into English was taken for granted, and it was only lately that it was examined as a site of postcolonial transformations.

This pattern is reinforced by a broader tendency within both postcolonial and decolonial thought to foreground modern regimes of power while leaving the premodern comparatively under-theorized. The result is an assumption of epistemic innocence attached to premodern power and its figures. Ibn Khaldûn thus appears as a medieval thinker outside the primary terrain of critique, rather than as a figure actively reconstituted within colonial knowledge systems through translation. In this sense, even the frequent accusations of racism directed at Ibn Khaldûn are themselves effects of this colonial reconfiguration—a question to which I return below.
zh: 另一个相关因素是，后殖民研究在很大程度上受萨义德《东方学》塑造，集中关注阿拉伯文学研究，对阿拉伯史学的关注却少得多；后者仍与萨义德的批判最初针对的思想领域更加紧密地相联系。
当时，翻译并未被视为后殖民研究的场域。甚至法农作品被译成英语这件事，也被当作理所当然；直到较近时期，它才被作为后殖民转化的场域加以考察。
后殖民与去殖民思想中一种更广泛的倾向，又强化了这一模式：凸显现代权力体制，却使前现代相对缺乏理论探讨。结果便是，前现代权力及其代表人物被预设具有知识上的无辜性。于是，伊本·赫勒敦显现为一位身处主要批判领域之外的中世纪思想家，而非一个通过翻译在殖民知识体系中被积极重新建构的人物。从这个意义上说，即使人们频繁指责伊本·赫勒敦具有种族主义，这些指责本身也是这种殖民重构的结果；下文将重新讨论这一问题。

en: This article focuses on French and English translations and their place within a colonial genealogy. Its primary concern is the transformation of Ibn Khaldûn’s thought within colonial modernity, particularly in the context of Algeria from the mid-nineteenth century onward. Later English translations extended the afterlife of the French text but remained tied to a genealogy traceable to de Slane.
zh: 本文聚焦法译本和英译本及其在殖民谱系中的位置。其首要关切是伊本·赫勒敦思想在殖民现代性中的转化，尤其是在19世纪中叶以来的阿尔及利亚语境中发生的转化。后来的英译本延续了法译本的后续生命，却仍然依附于一条可以追溯到德·斯兰的谱系。

en: The colonial archive analyzed in this article should therefore be understood as one among several historically situated reconfigurations of Ibn Khaldûn’s thought. What distinguishes that archive is that it translates his categories into a racial episteme that fundamentally alters their meaning. It is this transformation—rather than the original Arabic text—that underlies many modern interpretations of his work, including the construction of Ibn Khaldûn as a racist author.
zh: 因此，本文分析的殖民档案，应被理解为伊本·赫勒敦思想在具体历史处境中的若干次重新配置之一。这份档案的独特之处在于，它将其范畴转译进一种种族知识型，从根本上改变了这些范畴的意义。正是这种转化，而非阿拉伯语原文，构成许多现代阐释的基础，其中包括将伊本·赫勒敦建构为种族主义作者。

en: Colonizing Ibn Khaldûn
zh: 殖民化伊本·赫勒敦

en: Ibn Khaldûn’s reception in Europe unfolded within the broader framework of the Orientalist enterprise, closely tied to the systematic recovery and publication of Islamic manuscripts led by Silvestre de Sacy in the early 1800s. As Edward Said writes, “Sacy’s name is associated with the beginning of modern Orientalism…his work virtually put before the profession an entire systematic body of texts, a pedagogic practice, a scholarly tradition, and an important link between Oriental scholarship and public policy.”
Within this newly constituted archive, Ibn Khaldûn occupied a central place.
It may be, as I once wrote, the “greatest textual event in the history of French orientalism.
zh: 伊本·赫勒敦在欧洲的接受过程，是在东方学事业的更大框架中展开的，与西尔维斯特·德·萨西于19世纪初领导的伊斯兰手稿系统搜集与刊行工作密切相关。正如爱德华·萨义德所写：“萨西的名字与现代东方学的开端相联系……他的工作实际上向这一专业提供了一整套系统的文本、一种教学实践、一项学术传统，以及东方研究与公共政策之间的一条重要纽带。”
在这份新近建构的档案中，伊本·赫勒敦占据核心地位。
这或许正如我曾经写过的，是“法国东方学史上最重大的文本事件”。

en: As noted in the preceding section of this article, there were numerous copies of Ibn Khaldûn’s work throughout the Ottoman Empire, including in North Africa. Europe appears to have been familiar with Ibn Khaldûn before the colonial era. Manuscripts were actively acquired, particularly during the nineteenth century, and copies existed in France at the
, dating from the seventeenth or eighteenth century. The Ottoman Empire was a source of this knowledge, “a magnetic pole in the field of knowledge for scholarly Europe.”

Ibn Khaldûn had long been present in Europe, including in Paris, before the conquest of Algiers in July 1830. De Sacy encountered Ibn Khaldûn through the Arabic manuscripts and scholarly resources available to him in Paris. According to Lucette Valensi, de Sacy brought Ibn Khaldûn to prominence by virtue of his institutional position and the resources it placed at his disposal.

Yet this prominence reached its zenith under colonialism, which transformed Ibn Khaldûn’s status from that of a Muslim scholar, an Arab savant, into that of a colonial author whose work had a profound impact on the production of knowledge on the region and, beyond it, on colonial policy and the making of the colony.
zh: 如上一节所述，伊本·赫勒敦著作的众多抄本遍布奥斯曼帝国，包括北非地区。欧洲似乎在殖民时代之前就已熟悉伊本·赫勒敦。人们积极搜集手稿，尤其是在19世纪；法国国家图书馆中也藏有可追溯至17或18世纪的抄本。奥斯曼帝国是这些知识的来源，是“欧洲学术界知识场域中的一个磁极”。
早在1830年7月攻占阿尔及尔之前，伊本·赫勒敦便长期存在于欧洲，包括巴黎。德·萨西通过巴黎可得的阿拉伯语手稿和学术资源接触到伊本·赫勒敦。按照吕西特·瓦朗西的说法，德·萨西凭借其机构地位及由此掌握的资源，使伊本·赫勒敦受到重视。
然而，这种显著地位是在殖民主义下达到顶峰的：殖民主义将他从一位穆斯林学者、阿拉伯博学之士，转化为一位殖民作者；其著作深刻影响了有关该地区的知识生产，并进而影响殖民政策和殖民地的建构。

en: De Sacy was indeed instrumental in bringing Ibn Khaldûn into European Orientalist scholarship. In 1806, he published the first excerpts from the
, followed by more substantial passages in 1810. In 1818, he returned to Ibn Khaldûn with a more comprehensive appraisal of the

, declaring that no Arabic historical work deserved publication more. This positioned Ibn Khaldûn as a major figure within European understandings of Arabic historiography. For his contemporaries, de Sacy presented him not only as an outstanding historian but also as the author of a text that was relevant to the study of Algeria and valuable for public policy—signaling early on the dual destiny that awaited him in Europe: celebrated for originality, yet reconstructed through translation, commentary, and appropriation to serve imperial projects.
zh: 德·萨西确实在将伊本·赫勒敦引入欧洲东方学方面发挥了关键作用。1806年，他首次发表《历史绪论》的节选，1810年又刊出了更大篇幅的选段。1818年，他重新讨论伊本·赫勒敦，对《鉴戒之书》作出更全面的评价，宣称没有哪一部阿拉伯历史著作比它更值得出版。这使伊本·赫勒敦成为欧洲认识阿拉伯史学时的重要人物。在同时代人面前，德·萨西不仅将他呈现为一位杰出的历史学家，还将其文本呈现为有助于研究阿尔及利亚、对公共政策有价值的著作。这很早就预示了他在欧洲将遭遇的双重命运：因独创性受到赞颂，同时又经由翻译、评注和挪用而被重新建构，以服务于帝国计划。

en: Following de Sacy, his students and intellectual heirs undertook sustained efforts to disseminate Ibn Khaldûn’s ideas. In 1822, Joseph von Hammer-Purgstall published a detailed summary of the
in the

, emphasizing the urgency of translation. This was followed by Garcin de Tassy’s supplementary review in 1824 and F. E. Schulz’s extensive critical discussion in 1825, consolidating Ibn Khaldûn’s status within Orientalist scholarship and laying the groundwork for his later canonization.
zh: 继德·萨西之后，他的学生和思想继承人持续致力于传播伊本·赫勒敦的思想。1822年，约瑟夫·冯·哈默尔－普格施塔尔在《亚洲学报》（Journal Asiatique）发表《历史绪论》的详细提要，强调翻译工作的迫切性。随后，德·塔西于1824年发表补充评论，F. E. 舒尔茨于1825年发表长篇批评性讨论，进一步巩固了伊本·赫勒敦在东方学中的地位，并为其后来进入经典奠定基础。

en: Before proceeding further, it is necessary to outline the general structure of Ibn Khaldûn’s work and to situate it within the historical circumstances of its composition—an account that Ibn Khaldûn himself provides in the concluding autobiographical section of the
, entitled
zh: 在继续讨论之前，有必要概述伊本·赫勒敦著作的总体结构，并将其置于成书时的历史环境中；伊本·赫勒敦本人在《鉴戒之书》末尾题为《伊本·赫勒敦自述》（al-Taʿrîf bi Ibn Khaldûn）的自传部分，对此作了说明。

en: To appreciate how profoundly this reinterpretation altered Ibn Khaldûn, it is worth recalling the scope of his original work. Writing in a fourteenth-century Maghreb marked, in his view, by Arab supremacy, Berber weakness, and the devastation of plague, he sought to record the transformations of his own age. His history of the Berbers—set within a broader Islamic and universal history—was a defense of their achievements, inserting the Berbers into world history alongside Arabs, Persians, Greeks, and Romans. He even traced their genealogy back to Canaan, son of Noah, embedding them within sacred history.
zh: 要理解这种重新阐释对伊本·赫勒敦造成的改变有多么深刻，就有必要回顾其原著的范围。在他看来，14世纪的马格里布以阿拉伯人的强盛、柏柏尔人的衰弱及瘟疫的破坏为特征；他在这一背景下写作，力求记录自身时代的转变。他的柏柏尔人历史置于更广泛的伊斯兰史与世界史之中，为柏柏尔人的成就辩护，将他们与阿拉伯人、波斯人、希腊人和罗马人并列，纳入世界历史。他甚至将他们的谱系追溯到诺亚之子迦南，将其嵌入神圣历史。

en: The

, in its discursive totality, reveals Ibn Khaldûn’s vision and even Muslim historiographic imagination in medieval times: history is not a linear progression but a cyclical transformation. Tribes rise to power through

, or social cohesion, underpinned by religion, and then establish dynasties. These dynasties, within at most four generations, decay under the weight of luxury, injustice, and complacency, and are eventually replaced by a new group, a new tribe that goes through the same process of dynastic formation—from
to

Power, in Ibn Khaldûn’s understanding, was always contingent. No nation, as evidenced by the histories of the Greeks, the Persians, the Arabs, the Israelites, and the Berbers, was permanently dominant, and no dynasty, regardless of its might, was permanent.
zh: 从话语整体来看，《鉴戒之书》展现了伊本·赫勒敦的历史观，乃至中世纪穆斯林的史学想象：历史不是线性进步，而是循环转变。部落凭借由宗教支撑的ʿaṣabiyya，即社会凝聚力，崛起掌权，继而建立王朝。这些王朝至多经历四代，便在奢侈、不义与自满的重压下衰败，最终被一个新群体、一个新部落取代；后者又经历同样的王朝形成过程——从ʿaṣabiyya到dawla。在伊本·赫勒敦看来，权力总是取决于具体条件的。希腊人、波斯人、阿拉伯人、以色列人和柏柏尔人的历史证明，没有哪个民族能够永久居于支配地位，也没有哪个王朝，无论多么强大，能够永存。

en: Ibn Khaldûn’s original categories reflected a cyclical and contingent vision of history, since dynasties are subjected to patterns they reproduce, and one of these patterns is precisely their contingency. The category of
, a key concept in his analysis, points to temporality and change. The term
meant a generation, a group of people bound together by time, genealogy, or way of life. He could speak of
(the first generation of the Arabs) or
(the second generation of the Berbers), and he distinguished between
(the nomadic generation) and
(the urban, sedentary stage).
referred to strata or layers of society, while
designated a community of faith—most prominently, the community of Islam—or a historical community like “the Persians” or “the Arabs.”
zh: 伊本·赫勒敦原本的范畴体现了一种循环且具有偶然性的历史观，因为王朝受制于自身不断重演的模式，而其中一个模式恰恰就是其非恒定性。jîl是其分析中的关键概念，指向时间性和变化。jîl意味着世代，即由时间、谱系或生活方式联系起来的一群人。他可以谈论al-jîl al-awwal li al-ʿarab（阿拉伯人的第一代）或al-jîl al-thâni al-barbar（柏柏尔人的第二代），并区分jîl al-badw（游牧世代）与jîl al-ḥaḍar（城市、定居阶段）。Ṭabaqa指社会的阶层或层次，而umma指信仰共同体——最典型的是伊斯兰共同体——或像“波斯人”“阿拉伯人”这样的历史共同体。

en: Again, what unites these categories is their temporality and fluidity. Groups differed in power, cohesion, and customs, but none was inherently fixed as superior or inferior. Inequality was real; it existed between tribes and between nations in terms of

only, but it was never permanent. Ibn Khaldûn also explained differences in terms of environment and economy: climate affected skin color and temperament; livelihood shaped culture and customs. Above all, religion gave cohesion to a tribe’s
and allowed it to extend its reach; yet even religiously empowered dynasties succumbed to the same cycle of rise and fall.
zh: 再次强调，这些范畴的共同点在于时间性和流动性。不同群体在权力、凝聚力和习俗方面存在差异，但没有哪个群体被本质性地固定为优等或劣等。不平等真实存在；部落之间和民族之间的不平等，只是在ʿumrân方面存在，却从不永久不变。伊本·赫勒敦也用环境与经济来解释差异：气候影响肤色和性情，生计塑造文化与习俗。最重要的是，宗教使部落的ʿaṣabiyya获得凝聚力，并使其得以扩展影响范围；然而，即使获得宗教赋能的王朝，也会屈服于相同的兴衰循环。

en: When de Sacy emphasized the need to translate the

Joseph von Hammer-Purgstall, in contrast, stressed the urgency of translating the section concerning the history of the Berbers—that is, the second book of Ibn Khaldûn’s work. In 1847, de Slane, who served as the principal interpreter for the
, published the Arabic text of this section under the auspices of the Imprimerie du Gouvernement (Government Press). Seven years later, in 1854, he released the French translation under the title
zh: 德·萨西在强调翻译《历史绪论》的必要性时，也提出了法文标题Prolégomènes historiques（《历史导论》）；这一名称后来成为其学生德·斯兰法译本的正式标题。与之相对，约瑟夫·冯·哈默尔－普格施塔尔强调，应当尽快翻译有关柏柏尔人历史的部分，即伊本·赫勒敦著作的第二书。1847年，担任法国非洲军团首席译员的德·斯兰，在政府印刷所的支持下出版了这一部分的阿拉伯语文本。七年后的1854年，他以《柏柏尔人史》（L’histoire des Berbères）为题出版了法译本。

en: In 1858, Quatremère published the Arabic text of the
, which de Slane subsequently translated and published in 1863 under the title
The two texts followed distinct trajectories: the
became a valuable resource for sociologists such as Émile Durkheim and Robert Montagne, while
provided the structural foundation for the study of North African history.
Notably,
was commissioned and published by the Ministry of War, highlighting its perceived significance for the colonial administration. Joseph Reinaud remarked on this relevance: “

of Ibn Khaldûn could not fail to draw the attention of the French government. With the establishment of the French in Algeria, daily relations, contacts of friendships, and war have been established between them and the tribes that occupy the interior of the country.”
zh: 1858年，卡特梅尔出版了《历史绪论》的阿拉伯语文本；随后德·斯兰将其译成法语，于1863年以Prolégomènes为题出版。这两部文本走上了不同轨迹：《历史绪论》成为埃米尔·涂尔干和罗贝尔·蒙塔涅等社会学家的宝贵资源，而《柏柏尔人史》则为北非历史研究提供了结构性基础。
值得注意的是，《柏柏尔人史》由陆军部委托翻译并出版，凸显了它被认为对于殖民行政具有的重要意义。约瑟夫·雷诺就这种关联评论道：“伊本·赫勒敦的《柏柏尔人史》不可能不引起法国政府的注意。随着法国人在阿尔及利亚立足，他们与占据该国内陆的部落之间建立了日常关系、友好往来和战争关系。”

en: One can see that the discovery of Ibn Khaldûn was inscribed within the larger project of the colonial enterprise, which made knowledge a cornerstone of its policies to rule and to govern, and, by the same token, created colonial archives in which knowledge and power, politics, and episteme, are intertwined. This Ibn Khaldûn was a central part of the colonial archives, whose existence was initiated through translation.
zh: 由此可见，对伊本·赫勒敦的“发现”被铭刻在更广泛的殖民事业之中。殖民事业将知识作为其统治和治理政策的基石，同时创造出殖民档案，使知识与权力、政治与知识型相互交织。这位伊本·赫勒敦是殖民档案的核心组成部分，而其存在正是通过翻译开启的。

en: Translation as the Birthplace of Colonial Ibn Khaldûn
zh: 翻译：殖民伊本·赫勒敦的诞生之地

en: Arguably the most significant textual event in the history of Orientalism, Ibn Khaldûn, the colonial author, was born gradually and in fragments.
By 1850, however, this colonial author could be recognized in two distinct forms. The first is as the historian of a foundational text on North African history,
From the moment of its publication, this work became the central reference for French historians in constructing knowledge of the region that, from 1928 onward, came to be known as the Maghreb.
zh: 作为殖民作者的伊本·赫勒敦，是逐渐且以碎片形式诞生的；这可以说是东方学史上最重要的文本事件。
然而，到1850年，这位殖民作者已可以以两种不同形态被辨认出来。第一种形态，是作为北非历史奠基性文本《柏柏尔人史》的历史学家。自出版之初，这部著作就成为法国史家构建该地区知识时的核心参考，而该地区从1928年起被称为马格里布。

en: The second form is that of an epistemic authority—one who moves beyond narrating events to investigating their underlying causes, examining the formation of tribes, their rise to power, and the emergence of states that generate complex social structures, or

, characterized by the creation of sciences, crafts, and state organization itself. In the context of the development of social science around Durkheim and his circle, Ibn Khaldûn came to transcend the colonial Algerian context, becoming a major intellectual figure invoked across disciplines such as anthropology, sociology, economics, and history.

This emergence gave rise to what might be called “Khaldûnism,” analogous to the way we speak of Marxism—a discursive framework in which the authoritative colonial figure of Ibn Khaldûn eclipses the medieval scholar, largely through translation that reinterpreted him within a European epistemic paradigm.
zh: 第二种形态是知识权威：他不再止于叙述事件，而是探究其深层原因，考察部落的形成、崛起掌权，以及国家的出现；国家产生复杂的社会结构，即ʿumrân，其特征是科学、技艺乃至国家组织本身的创生。在围绕涂尔干及其学术圈发展的社会科学背景下，伊本·赫勒敦逐渐超出殖民时期阿尔及利亚的语境，成为人类学、社会学、经济学和历史学等多个学科援引的重要思想人物。
这一形成过程催生了可称为“赫勒敦主义”的东西，类似于我们所说的马克思主义：它是一种话语框架，在其中，具有权威的殖民形象伊本·赫勒敦遮蔽了那位中世纪学者；这主要是通过翻译完成的，因为翻译在欧洲知识范式中重新解释了他。

en: De Slane’s translations were prefaced by long introductions that did more than summarize; they actively reinterpreted the works and thereby shaped how the translated texts would be read. He declared Ibn Khaldûn’s Arabic “verbose and repetitive”

and in need of correction, positioning himself not as a mere translator but as a rectifier and commentator. In the introduction to his translation, de Slane provides what I call a historical narrative of a quest, a narrative with a plot—with heroes (Berbers) and villains (Arabs), and a narrative program consisting of the quest for liberation. Yet since this quest was not achieved within

itself, the introduction that de Slane wrote and added comes, in light of the subsequent colonization of Algeria, to suggest an unspoken quest—one in which the French implicitly become the heroes. They appear as liberators of the Berbers from the “Arab yoke,” a liberation that the French claimed to have achieved through the conquest of Algeria in 1830.
zh: 德·斯兰的译本配有长篇导言，其作用不仅是概括内容；它们积极重新解释原作，从而塑造读者阅读译文的方式。他宣称伊本·赫勒敦的阿拉伯语“冗长而重复”，

需要修正，由此将自己定位为校正者和评论者，而非仅仅是译者。在译本导言中，德·斯兰提供了一种我称为追寻历程的历史叙事：这是一种具有情节的叙事，有英雄（柏柏尔人）和恶人（阿拉伯人），其叙事程序是追求解放。然而，由于这一追求并未在《柏柏尔人史》本身中实现，联系到此后对阿尔及利亚的殖民，德·斯兰撰写并加上的导言便暗示了一个未明言的追寻历程，法国人在其中隐含地成为英雄。他们以将柏柏尔人从“阿拉伯枷锁”下解放出来的解放者形象出现；法国人宣称，自己通过1830年征服阿尔及利亚实现了这种解放。

en: If the introduction by de Slane is fused with a racial ideology that guides, if not shapes, the reader’s understanding of the text, the translated text is itself structured according to the racial ideology of the nineteenth century. De Slane translated Ibn Khaldûn’s categories into the racial semantics of nineteenth-century France.
is translated as “race.”

becomes “nation.” A “generation of Arabs” becomes “the Arab race.” A “generation of Berbers” becomes “the Berber race.” The fluid and contingent communities of Ibn Khaldûn’s imagination were thus frozen into racial blocs defined by antagonism. His concept of

—commonly used among Arab historiographers to mean the “opening” of an era of Islam, and understood positively as divine favor and spiritual transformation—was rendered as “conquest” or “domination,” terms connoting forced subordination and colonialism.
zh: 如果说德·斯兰的导言融合了一种引导、甚至塑造读者理解文本的种族意识形态，那么译文本身也是按照19世纪的种族意识形态组织起来的。德·斯兰将伊本·赫勒敦的范畴译入19世纪法国的种族语义系统：jîl被译成“种族”，umma变成“民族”，“阿拉伯人的一代”变成“阿拉伯种族”，“柏柏尔人的一代”变成“柏柏尔种族”。由此，伊本·赫勒敦想象中流动且取决于具体条件的共同体，被冻结为由对抗界定的种族集团。他的fatḥ概念——阿拉伯史家通常用它表示伊斯兰时代的“开启”，并赋予其神恩与精神转化的正面意义——被译成“征服”或“支配”，这些词带有强制臣服和殖民主义的意味。

en: De Slane’s translation created a discursive structure whereby the resulting text produced became a foundational colonial text while generating a variety of discourses—colonial, national, and postcolonial—still at work today. Ibn Khaldûn’s cyclical history of tribes became a racialized binary narrative of Arabs versus Berbers, domination versus resistance. His integrative defense of Berbers as equals to Arabs and other nations was transformed into a colonial ethnography in which Berbers were reimagined as originally European, white-skinned, democratic, heirs to Roman law, and therefore natural allies of France. Berbers were also defined in opposition to Arabs—nomadic, Oriental oppressors, destructive, and fanatical. Yet this translation, because it emerged in the colonial context, contained not only a binary opposition between Berbers and Arabs but also a tertiary relation in which the European is tacitly present and explicitly plays the role of a hero, a savior—the one who ended Arab domination with colonization and freed both the land, once Roman, and the Berbers, originally Europeans, from the hand of the villain, an Arab conqueror. The text of Ibn Khaldûn thus becomes a story of a quest, in which a new colonial narrative grammar is introduced, not just a new narrative syntax.
zh: 德·斯兰的翻译创造了一种话语结构：由此产生的文本成为殖民奠基性文本，同时生成多种至今仍在运作的话语——殖民话语、民族话语与后殖民话语。伊本·赫勒敦关于部落的循环历史，变成了阿拉伯人对柏柏尔人、支配对抵抗的种族化二元叙事。他原本将柏柏尔人与阿拉伯人及其他民族视为平等者、并将其纳入共同历史的辩护，被转化为一种殖民民族志。在其中，柏柏尔人被重新想象为原本是欧洲人，皮肤白皙，具有民主精神，是罗马法的继承者，因此是法国天然的盟友。柏柏尔人也被界定为阿拉伯人的对立面；后者被描绘为游牧的东方压迫者，具有破坏性且狂热。然而，由于这一翻译产生于殖民语境，它不仅包含柏柏尔人与阿拉伯人的二元对立，也包含一种三方关系：欧洲人暗中在场，并明确扮演英雄、救世主的角色——他们通过殖民终结了阿拉伯人的支配，将曾属于罗马的土地及本为欧洲人的柏柏尔人，从恶人即阿拉伯征服者手中解放出来。于是，伊本·赫勒敦的文本成为一个追寻故事，其中被引入的不只是新的叙事句法，而是一套新的殖民叙事语法。

en: This transformation was made possible by the intellectual climate of nineteenth-century France, where race was treated as an essential category for understanding human diversity, condition, and development. It was the same climate that made history an undeniable mark of modernity itself,

showing the unfolding of history and the rise of modern Europe as a universal civilization. Thinkers such as Arthur de Gobineau, Hippolyte Taine, and Ernest Renan defined history in terms of races and nations. For Gobineau, races were inherently unequal, with the Aryan race uniquely capable of creating civilization.
Taine studied the “genius” of races as expressed in literature and art.

Renan, who knew of Ibn Khaldûn, defined nations as communities built on shared memories and forgetting; he also insisted that Semitic peoples—Arabs and Jews alike—were incapable of science and liberal government.
zh: 这种转变之所以可能，是因为19世纪法国的思想环境把种族视为理解人类多样性、处境和发展的根本范畴。同样的思想环境也使历史成为现代性本身无可否认的标志，
将历史的展开与现代欧洲的崛起呈现为一种普遍文明的形成。阿蒂尔·德·戈比诺、伊波利特·泰纳和欧内斯特·勒南等思想家，用种族与民族来界定历史。在戈比诺看来，种族具有先天的不平等，只有雅利安种族有能力创造文明。
泰纳研究各种族在文学与艺术中表现的“天才”。
了解伊本·赫勒敦的勒南，将民族界定为建立在共同记忆与遗忘之上的共同体；他也坚持认为，闪米特诸民族——阿拉伯人与犹太人皆包括在内——没有能力从事科学或建立自由政府。

en: De Slane’s translation turned the Arabic text into a racial text regulated by colonial and racial categories. Where Ibn Khaldûn saw contingent cycles of power, de Slane presented permanent racial antagonisms between Arabs and Berbers. Where Ibn Khaldûn emphasized environment, livelihood and solidarity, and fluidity, de Slane reduced difference to timeless racial essences. The result was a colonial narrative that not only explained the Arab conquest of North Africa but also made the French one appear as a natural correction of a historical mistake: the French returned to their Roman ancestral land. If Algeria had always been a land where Berbers resisted Arab domination, then France was simply the latest heir to Rome, liberating Berbers from the yoke of Semitic oppression, correcting history, and righting the wrong.
zh: 德·斯兰的翻译将阿拉伯语文本转化为一个受殖民与种族范畴规制的种族文本。伊本·赫勒敦看到的是取决于具体条件的权力循环，德·斯兰呈现的却是阿拉伯人与柏柏尔人之间永久的种族对抗。伊本·赫勒敦强调环境、生计、团结及流动性，德·斯兰则将差异归结为超越时间的种族本质。其结果是一种殖民叙事：它不仅解释阿拉伯人对北非的征服，也使法国人的征服看起来像是对一项历史错误的自然纠正——法国人回到了其罗马祖先的土地。如果阿尔及利亚始终是一片柏柏尔人抵抗阿拉伯支配的土地，那么法国便不过是罗马最新的继承者，它将柏柏尔人从闪米特压迫的枷锁中解救出来，纠正历史，匡正不义。

en: This logic was reinforced by colonial ethnography. French officials and scholars described Berbers as democratic, secular, and European in spirit. Census statistics portrayed Algeria as overwhelmingly Berber-European in origin, with Arabs a minority intrusion.

The genealogical defense of Berbers that Ibn Khaldûn had articulated—tracing them to Canaan and integrating them into Islamic history—was dismissed as an error. In its place stood a myth of Berber whiteness and European kinship, a myth that conveniently aligned with French colonial policy.
zh: 殖民民族志进一步强化了这一逻辑。法国官员与学者将柏柏尔人描述为具有民主性、世俗性及欧洲精神。人口普查统计把阿尔及利亚呈现为一个绝大多数人口源于柏柏尔—欧洲血统的地方，而阿拉伯人只是少数外来侵入者。
伊本·赫勒敦提出的谱系辩护——把柏柏尔人追溯到迦南，并纳入伊斯兰历史——被斥为错误。取而代之的是关于柏柏尔人白人身份及其欧洲亲缘关系的神话，这一神话恰好与法国殖民政策相契合。

en: Like any translation, the French text bears witness to the existence of an original voice—one that speaks in the language and logic of its time, deploying its own categories, assumptions, and conception of time, even its own narrative organization, which unfolds according to an order different from that of modern narrative.

Ibn Khaldûn’s narrative in Arabic seems chaotic when in fact it was subject to a different medieval episteme, one in which language was believed not to translate the real but to tell it, as is. And since the real does not follow a linear logic, a narrative need not tell a story with a plot, a beginning, and an end. Hence, we have the textual phenomenon of repetition, often verbatim and without attribution, in the work of medieval historians. But Ibn Khaldûn’s seemingly chaotic organization was itself semiotically ordered first by the introduction of de Slane and later by subsequent colonial historians, most notably Ernest Mercier and Émile-Félix Gautier, at a time when the colony shifted toward being a historiographic state rather than an ethnographic one.
zh: 如同任何翻译，法语文本也见证了一个原初声音的存在：这个声音以其时代的语言和逻辑说话，运用自身的范畴、预设和时间观，甚至具有自己的叙事组织方式，依照不同于现代叙事的秩序展开。

伊本·赫勒敦的阿拉伯语叙事看似混乱，实际上却服从另一种中世纪知识型；在其中，人们相信语言并非转译现实，而是如其所是地叙说现实。由于现实并不遵循线性逻辑，叙事也不必讲述一个具有情节、开端和结尾的故事。因此，中世纪史家的著作中便存在重复这一文本现象，往往是逐字重复且不注明出处。不过，伊本·赫勒敦这种看似混乱的组织方式，首先经由德·斯兰的导言，随后经由其他殖民历史学家——尤其是欧内斯特·梅西耶和埃米尔－费利克斯·戈蒂耶——而在符号层面被重新赋予秩序；这一过程发生于殖民地从民族志国家转向史学国家之时。

en: It is important to draw attention to the fact that the

was not only the birthplace of the opposition between Arabs and Berbers as exclusive races, rather than as tribal formations that change and transform through the dynamics of history, it was also a text on human diversity as it existed in Ibn Khaldûn’s time, and its translation transformed this understanding of human diversity as well.
zh: 需要注意的是，《历史绪论》不仅成为阿拉伯人与柏柏尔人作为相互排斥的种族之间对立的诞生之地，使他们不再被视为随历史动力而变化、转型的部落组织；它还讨论了伊本·赫勒敦时代实际存在的人类多样性，而翻译同样改变了这种对人类多样性的理解。

en: To wit, for Ibn Khaldûn, human diversity is the result of climate—hot, temperate, and cold—depending on the region under discussion. The translated text, however, introduced nineteenth-century racial categories into this discussion. While Ibn Khaldûn speaks of the people of the Sudan as inhabitants of a hot climate, de Slane changed the category to “Negroes,” a nineteenth-century racial category associated with savagery and primitiveness. I shall return to this question shortly.
zh: 具体而言，在伊本·赫勒敦看来，人类多样性是气候的结果：根据所讨论地区的不同，气候分为炎热、温和与寒冷。然而，译文在这一讨论中引入了19世纪的种族范畴。伊本·赫勒敦将苏丹地区的人们描述为炎热气候的居民，德·斯兰却将这一范畴改成“Negroes”（黑人），这是19世纪一个与野蛮及原始性相联系的种族范畴。我稍后将回到这一问题。

en: The question now is not simply how colonial Ibn Khaldûn gained an order of importance not given to other historians or thinkers in modern times, but why. My argument is that the importance created and bestowed upon an author through translation—thus transforming him into a colonial author—is itself a marker of coloniality that must be interrogated. Importance, therefore, should be understood as a site of discourse, distinct from yet related to the original discourse of Ibn Khaldûn, one that must be unpacked to reveal how colonial power constructs historiographic authority and imbues its representations with the quality of the real.
zh: 现在的问题，不仅是殖民伊本·赫勒敦如何获得其他历史学家或思想家在现代未曾获得的那种重要地位，而且是为什么。我认为，通过翻译为一位作者创造并赋予重要性，从而将其转化为殖民作者，这件事本身就是殖民性的一项标志，需要加以追问。因此，重要性应被理解为一个话语场域，它区别于伊本·赫勒敦的原初话语，又与之相关；必须对它加以剖析，才能揭示殖民权力如何建构史学权威，并赋予其表述以现实性。

en: Colonial Erasure and the Production of Relevance
zh: 殖民抹除与关联地位的生产

en: Colonialism, as a cultural enterprise—relying not just on the use of force but also on harnessing knowledge to govern and rule—created for itself as a distinct knowledge, one different from the knowledge the bourgeois state developed in the metropole. Colonial knowledge was the direct encounter of the colonizer and the colonized, of power and its domain, its apparatus and its objects. Colonialism had its own epistemology, its own ways of knowing, grounded in a specific philosophy of knowledge, in which the colonial power operated with categories that were often inapplicable to the terrain of the metropole—race, inferiority, savagery, primitiveness—fueled by an epistemic arrogance that made colonial authorities believe that whatever lay beyond Europe was fully knowable through a European gaze. Colonial knowledge, through its texts, also had its own style, its own aesthetics, its own tone, and its own judgment. Colonialism also created its own conception of authorship, its own system of references, its own closed system of knowledge, its own logic and assumptions—in short, its own episteme connected to but different from the one that produced and organized knowledge in the metropole.
zh: 殖民主义作为一种文化事业，不仅依靠武力，也借助知识来治理与统治，为自身创造了一种独特知识，它不同于资产阶级国家在宗主国发展出来的知识。殖民知识产生于殖民者与被殖民者、权力与其统辖领域、权力装置与其对象之间的直接相遇。殖民主义具有自己的知识论、自己的认识方式，奠基于一种特定的知识哲学；在其中，殖民权力运用的范畴往往不适用于宗主国领域，例如种族、低劣、野蛮、原始性。它受到一种知识傲慢的驱动，使殖民当局相信，欧洲之外的一切都可以通过欧洲的目光得到充分认识。殖民知识也通过其文本拥有自身的风格、美学、语调与判断。殖民主义还创造了自身的作者观、引证体系、封闭知识系统、逻辑与预设——简言之，它有自身的知识型，与在宗主国生产并组织知识的知识型相联系，却又有所不同。

en: The translation of Ibn Khaldûn marked the birth of a major colonial author, one that overshadows all previous (and even future) historians from the region and of the region. The text of Ibn Khaldûn known as

served as the foundation of colonial and, later, national and even postcolonial knowledge of North Africa. He has served as an author, in the Foucauldian sense, meaning someone who not only produced his own work but also “the possibility of other texts.”

Yet, this colonial author is himself a transfiguration of the medieval Ibn Khaldûn. In modern times, he says more than what he meant in medieval times: in both French and English, he speaks a racial language in which Arabs and Berbers are constructed as two races in complete opposition to each other, and in which “Negroes” seem to occupy the lowest rung of the human racial hierarchy. In Arabic, by contrast, the text of Ibn Khaldûn is a chronicle in a historiographic tradition that takes the tribe, not the nation, as the focal point of its analysis. In this text, one reads narratives about different Arab and Berber tribes, all of them subject to the same pattern: either dominated by others or dominating them, either reaching the status of statehood through
and
or remaining at the tribal level, perhaps waiting their turn to ascend to statehood if the conditions are favorable (that is, if the
and the

are aligned to make such an ascension possible). In the Arabic text, people are assigned a geography that seems to affect everything about them, from color to culture. The French text turns these narratives into a narrative of a quest where Arabs and Berbers are constantly fighting over dominance, with the former always dominating and the latter always dominated. This is a Eurocentric narrative framework consisting of a racial antagonism that never ends. But it is this framework that dominates, to this day, the history of the Maghreb so much so that it has served as the basis for the construction of the Maghreb, an entity that is neither Africa nor the Middle East, but instead either Arab (in one nationalist discourse) or Berber (in another, antagonistic nationalist discourse, i.e., Berber/Amazigh).
zh: 对伊本·赫勒敦的翻译，标志着一位重要殖民作者的诞生；他遮蔽了此前乃至此后所有来自该地区、或书写该地区的历史学家。伊本·赫勒敦那部被称为《柏柏尔人史》的文本，成为关于北非的殖民知识，以及后来的民族知识乃至后殖民知识的基础。他发挥了福柯意义上的作者作用：不仅生产自己的作品，也生产“其他文本的可能性”。

然而，这位殖民作者本身就是中世纪伊本·赫勒敦的变形。在现代，他说出的东西超过了中世纪时的原意：无论在法语还是英语中，他都说着一种种族语言，将阿拉伯人和柏柏尔人建构为完全相互对立的两个种族，并使“Negroes”（黑人）似乎占据人类种族等级的最底层。相比之下，阿拉伯语的伊本·赫勒敦文本是一种史学传统中的编年史，其分析焦点是部落而非民族。在这一文本中，人们读到不同阿拉伯部落与柏柏尔部落的叙事；所有部落都遵循同一模式：要么被别人支配，要么支配别人；要么通过ʿaṣabiyya与dîn达到国家地位，要么停留在部落层次，或许等待有利条件出现、轮到自己上升为国家——也就是说，等待ʿaṣabiyya与dîn相互配合，使这种上升成为可能。在阿拉伯语文本中，人们被置于某种地理环境，而这一环境似乎影响着他们从肤色到文化的一切。法语文本将这些叙事改写成一场追寻历程：阿拉伯人与柏柏尔人不断争夺支配地位，前者总是支配者，后者总是被支配者。这是一个以永不终止的种族对抗构成的欧洲中心主义叙事框架。然而，正是这一框架至今仍主导马格里布的历史，甚至成为建构马格里布这一实体的基础：它既不是非洲，也不是中东，而是在一种民族主义话语中属于阿拉伯人，在另一种与之对抗的民族主义话语——即柏柏尔／阿马齐格话语——中属于柏柏尔人。

en: Within all these discourses (colonial, national, even postcolonial), the name of Ibn Khaldûn functions as the highest historiographic authority. This functioning was made possible by colonial judgments on the man. For instance, R. A. Nicholson considers him “an extraordinary genius”
whose “intellectual descendants are the great medieval and modern historians of Europe—Machiavelli and Vico and Gibbon.”
French Orientalist Régis Blachère describes him as a “solitary” mind who “arose all of a sudden to explain the profound causes of history.”
Blachère suggests that such a mind did not have an echo in a world that was not prepared to receive him. Jacques Berque rephrases the idea, calling Ibn Khaldûn “the genius who has long been ignored.”
Robert Brunschvig phrases the stereotype differently: “As he had no predecessors in the Arabic language, he had no imitators or successors until the present era.”
Brunschvig continues: “The paths were not ready yet in Islam to receive his methods and his free examination, and to apply scientific research to the evolution of humanity.”

He then adds: “One of the most moving dramas, one of the most dramatic and significant pages in the history of Muslim culture, is that of the systematic incomprehension and resolute hostility that faced, in his own world, this genius and aberrant thinker.”
zh: 在所有这些话语——殖民、民族，乃至后殖民话语——中，伊本·赫勒敦的名字都作为最高史学权威发挥作用。这种作用之所以可能，是因为殖民语境中对他的评价。例如，R. A. 尼科尔森将他视为“一位非凡的天才”，
其“思想后裔是欧洲中世纪及现代的伟大史家——马基雅维利、维柯与吉本”。
法国东方学家雷吉斯·布拉谢尔将他描述为一位“孤独”的思想者，“突然出现，解释历史的深层原因”。
布拉谢尔暗示，这样的思想在一个尚未准备好接受他的世界里没有得到回应。雅克·贝尔克换一种说法，称伊本·赫勒敦为“长期被忽视的天才”。
罗贝尔·布伦施维格以另一种措辞表达这一刻板印象：“正如他在阿拉伯语中没有先驱一样，直到当今时代，他也没有模仿者或继承者。”
布伦施维格接着写道：“伊斯兰世界的道路尚未铺好，还不能接受他的方法与自由探究，也不能将科学研究应用于人类演进。”
随后他又补充：“穆斯林文化史上最令人动容的戏剧、最富戏剧性与意义的篇章之一，就是这位天才而离经叛道的思想家在自己的世界中遭遇的系统性不理解和坚决敌视。”

en: These judgments extend beyond the Maghreb to reappear in the Anglo-American tradition among historians, philosophers, and even economists. Arnold J. Toynbee speaks of Ibn Khaldûn as “an Arab genius”; he continues, “Ibn Khaldun’s star shines more brightly by contrast with the foil of darkness against which it flashes out,” and goes on to describe the
as “the greatest work of its kind that has ever yet been created by any mind in any time or place.”

These formulations circulate widely. Charles Issawi, for instance, reproduces Toynbee’s statement as an epigraph, thereby reinscribing this evaluative framework within an Arab intellectual context. He cites Toynbee’s characterization of Ibn Khaldûn: “Ibn Khaldûn’s star shines the more brightly by contrast with the foil of darkness against which it flashes out.… He is indeed the one outstanding personality in the history of a civilization whose social life on the whole was solitary, poor, nasty, brutish, and short.”
zh: 这些评价超出马格里布地区，在英美传统的历史学家、哲学家乃至经济学家中再次出现。阿诺德·J. 汤因比称伊本·赫勒敦为“一位阿拉伯天才”，并接着说：“伊本·赫勒敦这颗星，在其闪现时所面对的黑暗背景衬托下，显得格外明亮。”他又把《历史绪论》描述为“任何时代、任何地方的任何心智迄今创造的同类作品中最伟大的一部”。
这些表述广为流传。例如，查尔斯·伊萨维将汤因比的说法作为题辞，从而把这一评价框架重新铭刻到阿拉伯思想语境中。他引述汤因比对伊本·赫勒敦的描述：“伊本·赫勒敦这颗星，在其闪现时所面对的黑暗背景衬托下，越发明亮……他的确是一种文明史上唯一杰出的人物，而这种文明的社会生活总体上是孤独、贫困、肮脏、野蛮而短促的。”

en: Beyond these judgments, however, lies what is explicitly acknowledged—namely, Ibn Khaldûn’s excellence, if he indeed excelled—and what is also implicitly stated: the contrast between his achievement and the perceived mediocrity of his Arab-Muslim milieu and the medieval era in which he lived. He is the exception that confirms the rule, and the rule is that Muslim civilization is “solitary, poor, nasty, brutish, and short.” Ibn Khaldûn thus becomes a colonial signifier of a double cultural deficiency: he is outstanding in a poor civilization; he shines within its darkness. An unmistakable sign of this intrinsic darkness is the inability to recognize the light that was Ibn Khaldûn. One can see how Ibn Khaldûn has become a site of colonial judgments on Arab culture and a locus for making and reinforcing racial stereotypes. This is a cognitive

that simultaneously asserts the superiority of the Orientalist instance of enunciation. He is certainly acknowledged, but this very acknowledgment often functions to detach him from his culture and his epoch. Such detachment opens the possibility of reattaching him to Europe—not only because Europe “discovered” him, but because Orientalist discourse can claim that he somehow belongs to it. After all, he was Andalusian and the al-Andalus is Europe. Gautier himself carries this logic to its most explicit conclusion, in al-Andalus, he wrote, “a breath of the Renaissance of the West reaches the oriental soul of Ibn Khaldun.”
zh: 然而，在这些评价背后，一方面是明确承认的东西，即伊本·赫勒敦的卓越——如果他的确卓越；另一方面则是隐含表达的东西：他的成就与其阿拉伯—穆斯林环境、以及他所处中世纪时代被认为的平庸之间的对照。他成为证实规则的例外，而这条规则就是：穆斯林文明“孤独、贫困、肮脏、野蛮而短促”。伊本·赫勒敦于是成为双重文化缺陷的殖民能指：他在贫乏的文明中出类拔萃，在其黑暗中熠熠生辉。这种内在黑暗的一个明确标志，就是无法识别伊本·赫勒敦这道光。可以看到，伊本·赫勒敦如何成为殖民判断阿拉伯文化的场域，以及制造并强化种族刻板印象的场所。这是一种认知装置（dispositif），同时宣示了东方学言说位置的优越性。他当然得到了承认，但这种承认本身往往起到将他从自身文化与时代中剥离出来的作用。这种剥离为将他重新归入欧洲创造了可能：不仅因为欧洲“发现”了他，也因为东方学话语可以宣称，他在某种意义上属于欧洲。毕竟，他是安达卢斯人，而安达卢斯就是欧洲。戈蒂耶本人把这一逻辑推向最明确的结论：他写道，在安达卢斯，“西方文艺复兴的一缕气息触及了伊本·赫勒敦的东方灵魂”。

en: Yet the complexity of the making of this historiographic figure does not allow for only one judgment to prevail; often there were also opposing views that celebrated him as outstanding while simultaneously excluding him from the sphere of Europe. In other words, the system of exclusion that constitutes the “Western tradition” as a white, upper-class, androcentric framework demands that even Ibn Khaldûn could not fully belong to it. He is outstanding “there,” but not “here.” The “here” is the terrain of Europe, and the colonial system of erasure encompasses Ibn Khaldûn himself, regardless of what Gautier, Toynbee, Blachère, Berque, Brunschvig, or Issawi might say about him. After all, Orientalist judgments are not binding outside their field, and that field remains at the margins of contemporary Western thought and the academy. Once highly influential, particularly during the nineteenth century, Oriental studies’ prominence has declined since the 1960s.
zh: 然而，这一史学人物的建构如此复杂，不可能只有一种评价占据主导；往往也存在相反的看法，一面称颂他的卓越，一面又将其排除在欧洲范围之外。换言之，将“西方传统”构造为白人、上层阶级、男性中心框架的排斥系统，要求即使是伊本·赫勒敦也不能完全属于这一传统。他在“那里”是杰出的，在“这里”却不是。“这里”是欧洲的领域，而殖民抹除系统也将伊本·赫勒敦本人包括在内，无论戈蒂耶、汤因比、布拉谢尔、贝尔克、布伦施维格或伊萨维怎样评价他。毕竟，东方学的判断在自身领域之外并不具有约束力，而该领域仍处于当代西方思想和学术界的边缘。东方研究曾经影响巨大，尤其是在19世纪，但自20世纪60年代起，其显著地位便有所衰落。

en: Outside Orientalist studies and the broader history of European thought, Ibn Khaldûn is largely absent from arenas reserved for figures such as Machiavelli, Hobbes, Durkheim, and even dissident thinkers like Karl Marx, Antonio Gramsci, and Pierre Bourdieu. In colonial discourse, he is confined to a regional niche, excluded from mainstream narratives of Western intellectual history. Although Durkheim was familiar with Ibn Khaldûn’s work, the similarities between their ideas are often minimized or deemed coincidental. Similarly, Ibn Khaldûn’s insights concerning how social status affects wealth, which anticipate Bourdieu’s concept of the “economy of symbolic goods,” have never received attention, despite Bourdieu’s reliance on colonial scholarship on Algeria, where Ibn Khaldûn was ubiquitous.
zh: 在东方学研究之外、在更广泛的欧洲思想史中，伊本·赫勒敦基本缺席于那些留给马基雅维利、霍布斯、涂尔干，乃至卡尔·马克思、安东尼奥·葛兰西和皮埃尔·布迪厄等异议思想家的领域。在殖民话语中，他被限制在一个区域性的狭小位置，被排除在西方思想史的主流叙述之外。尽管涂尔干熟悉伊本·赫勒敦的著作，二者思想的相似之处却往往被淡化或视为巧合。同样，伊本·赫勒敦关于社会地位如何影响财富的见解，预示了布迪厄的“象征物品经济”概念，却从未得到关注，尽管布迪厄依赖关于阿尔及利亚的殖民学术，而伊本·赫勒敦在其中无处不在。

en: Race and Blackness in Ibn Khaldûn’s Colonial Archive
zh: 伊本·赫勒敦殖民档案中的种族与黑人身份

en: As we have seen, the translation of the

transformed it into a racialized text governed by nineteenth-century categories that reclassified tribal formations as racial ones—for example, Berber tribes were recast as the “Berber race,” Arab tribes as the “Arab race,” and the peoples of the Sudan as “Negroes.” As a result, Ibn Khaldûn’s work, as it exists within the colonial archive, is permeated by racial semantics that are largely constitutive of that archive itself.
zh: 如前所见，《历史绪论》的翻译将其转化为一个受19世纪范畴支配的种族化文本，把部落组织重新归类为种族组织：例如，柏柏尔部落被重塑为“柏柏尔种族”，阿拉伯部落被重塑为“阿拉伯种族”，苏丹地区各人群则被重塑为“Negroes”（黑人）。结果是，存在于殖民档案中的伊本·赫勒敦著作充斥着种族语义，而这些语义在很大程度上正是该档案本身的构成要素。

en: In the context of integrating the
into the curriculum of an African research institute (the Makerere Institute of Social Research in Kampala), Mahmood Mamdani asks: “Was Ibn Khaldûn a racist?”

This question goes beyond Ibn Khaldûn himself. Underlying it is the issue of race: whether Islam historically recognized race and racism—whether the anti-Black prejudice observed in contemporary Arab societies is a European import brought with modernity, or whether Islam developed forms of racial hierarchy and anti-Black attitudes prior to Europe. In this debate, Ibn Khaldûn serves as a major reference, especially since he is considered “very much a representative of Arab culture,” particularly in domains pertaining to “his consideration of time, human psychology, and the nature of relationships.”

His centrality as an Arab thinker explains why his work has become a key reference in racial studies, and more specifically Black studies, especially as they relate not only to the Maghreb, but also to Islam at large—and today more so, as the region has been experiencing significant Black migration en route to Europe.
The racial language found in the
has become part of Ibn Khaldûn, the colonial archive.

In other words, with “only” added, the statement becomes viscerally and unquestionably racist, thereby reinforcing Lewis’s broader claim that Arab culture is fundamentally anti-Black.

zh: 甚至在弗朗茨·罗森塔尔的英译本于1958年问世之前，塞德里克·多佛便已于1952年在声称证明伊本·赫勒敦的种族主义之后得出结论：“在种族观念史上，我不知道还有哪本书比这更重要。”
伯纳德·刘易斯考察查尔斯·伊萨维的译文——“Negroes［苏丹人］是唯一接受奴役的人群”——时指出，罗森塔尔的译文省略了“唯一”一词。换言之，加上“唯一”之后，这句话便成为一种令人强烈反感、毫无疑问的种族主义表述，从而强化了刘易斯关于阿拉伯文化根本上反黑人的更广泛主张。

然而，这里需要指出，伊本·赫勒敦在阿拉伯语文本中并未使用表示排他性的“唯一”；如果他这样写，那么他无疑会显得对所有黑人都抱有种族主义。相反，他使用了与之相反的词语fi al-ghalib（一般而言），表示相对性。他写道：innama tudhʿinu li al-riqq fi al-ghalib umamu al-sudan（“屈从于奴役的，一般是苏丹地区各人群”）。这一短语中没有任何相当于“唯一”的阿拉伯语词，如faqaṭ、faḥasb、waḥdahum、lâ ghayr等。

伊本·赫勒敦并非对这些人群的价值作出判断，而是在指出一种历史模式：在其时代已为人知、由战争与奴隶贸易造成的现象。他也提及其他接受奴役而并非黑人的人群，尽管理由不同，例如东方的突厥人、不信教的加利西亚人，以及安达卢斯那些为头衔与权力而接受奴役的法兰克人。不过，伊本·赫勒敦将这一关于苏丹地区人们的观念，与他此前的意见相联系：这些人群之所以屈从或接受奴役，是因为他们“缺少人性”（nuqs fi al-insâniya），其特征（aʿrâḍ）更接近（aqrab）“不会说话的动物”。这些描述反映了他14世纪的世界观，以及他理解社会差异的框架，特别是有利于或阻碍ʿumrân形成的条件；但它们也必须在战争、奴役及跨撒哈拉奴隶贸易的背景下理解，因为这些因素塑造了其时代的支配模式。

伊本·赫勒敦谴责这些，并不是因为它们在宗教上受到禁止，而是因为它们与ʿumrân的衰落相关，并且不具有生产效用。然而，ʿumrân（文化）或其补充形态haḍâra（文明），并不是任何一个人群或民族的专属。它们出现在温和气候中，无论居住者是谁，包括黑人，如加纳的情况；但它们不能出现在极端气候中，无论居住者是谁，包括斯拉夫人，即白人。

en: In racial theories of the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries, Blacks (referred to as Negroes) were considered a “low race,” including in the view of the Enlightenment. Regardless of climate or geography, in racial thinking Blacks are Blacks. Kant asserts: “The Negroes of Africa have by nature no feeling that rises above the trifling. Mr. Hume challenges anyone to cite a single example in which a Negro has shown talents, and asserts that among the hundreds of thousands of blacks who are transported elsewhere from their countries, although many of them have even been set free, still not a single one was ever found who presented anything great in art and science or any other praise-worthy quality even though among the whites some continually rise aloft from the lowest rabble, and through superior gifts earn respect in the world. So fundamental is the difference between the two races of man, and it appears to be as great in regard to mental capacities as in colour.”
zh: 在18和19世纪的种族理论中，黑人被称为Negroes，被视为一个“低等种族”，启蒙思想也包括在内。在种族思维中，无论气候或地理如何，黑人就是黑人。康德断言：“非洲的黑人生来就没有任何超出琐屑事物的情感。休谟先生挑战任何人举出一个黑人显示才智的例子，并断言，在从本国被运往别处的数十万黑人之中，尽管许多人甚至已获自由，却从来没有发现任何一个人在艺术、科学或任何其他值得称赞的品质上表现出伟大之处；而在白人当中，总有人不断从最低下的民众中脱颖而出，凭借卓越天赋赢得世人的尊重。这两个人类种族之间的差别如此根本，在心智能力方面似乎与肤色方面一样巨大。”

en: For nineteenth-century racial theorists—most notably the highly influential Arthur de Gobineau—human populations were hierarchically classified. Gobineau explicitly placed what he termed “the Negro race” at the bottom of this hierarchy, writing that “the negroid variety is the lowest and stands at the foot of the ladder.”

By contrast, he identified “the white race”—by which he meant a particular Europe—as inherently superior in intelligence, beauty, and moral capacity, regardless of geography or historical circumstance.
zh: 对19世纪种族理论家，尤其是影响极大的阿蒂尔·德·戈比诺而言，人类群体被按等级分类。戈比诺明确将他所说的“黑人种族”放在这一等级体系的底部，写道：“类黑人的变种最低等，处于阶梯的最下端。”
相反，他将“白人种族”——他所指的是一个特定的欧洲——认定为在智力、美貌和道德能力上具有内在优越性，不受地理或历史环境影响。

It has even been reported that most of the Negroes of the first zone dwell in caves and thickets, eat herbs, live in savage isolation, do not congregate, and eat each other.

en: In this translation, the key phrase “the same applies to the Slavs” is omitted almost exclusively by those who claim that Ibn Khaldûn held racist views. The reason should be obvious. The statement cuts against racial thinking, since race—once posited as race—is supposed to remain fixed, not something that could be shared among different peoples with entirely different conditions, cultures, or civilizational statuses. Slavs are, of course, white, though “white” itself is a modern category.
zh: 在这一译文中，关键短语“斯拉夫人也是如此”，几乎总被那些声称伊本·赫勒敦抱有种族主义观点的人省略。原因应当显而易见。这一陈述与种族思维相抵触，因为种族一旦被设定为种族，就理应保持固定，而不应成为处境、文化或文明状态完全不同的各人群可以共同具有的东西。斯拉夫人当然是白人，尽管“白人”本身也是一个现代范畴。

en: If a negative stereotype targets a group of people who are white (not all white people) and another group who are Black (not all Black people), the stereotype—still offensive to both groups—operates according to a paradigm outside the racial episteme. Race is a form of biological classification, and racial thinking is systematic in that its key concept is race itself. A mode of thought that explains human difference primarily through geography and climate is doing something else entirely. It is climatic thinking, not racial thinking.
zh: 如果一种负面刻板印象针对一个白人群体——并非所有白人——以及另一个黑人群体——并非所有黑人，那么这种刻板印象虽仍然冒犯两个群体，却是在种族知识型之外的范式中运作。种族是一种生物学分类形式，而种族思维具有系统性，因为其关键概念就是种族本身。一种主要通过地理与气候解释人类差异的思维方式，所做的完全是另一回事：它是气候思维，而非种族思维。

en: Climatic thinking can indeed produce hierarchical zones of geography, but not of biology. There is a fundamental difference between the climatic thinking of medieval Islam and the racial thinking of colonial modernity: the former produces an anthropology of environment, the latter a doctrine of racial superiority. In the Arabic text of Ibn Khaldûn, there is no claim of racial superiority, since dominance is contingent and never fixed.
zh: 气候思维确实能够产生地理区域的等级，却并不产生生物学等级。中世纪伊斯兰的气候思维与殖民现代性的种族思维之间存在根本差别：前者产生环境人类学，后者产生种族优越论。在伊本·赫勒敦的阿拉伯语文本中，没有种族优越性的主张，因为支配地位取决于具体条件，从不固定。

en: What is significant, however, is that the conditions Ibn Khaldûn attributes to the inhabitants of extreme climates—such as cave-dwelling, dressing in leaves, and even cannibalism—are also reported by modern ethnographers across different cultures.

For Ibn Khaldûn, these conditions are indicative of the limits imposed on human societies by climate, not of biological determinism. Biological hierarchies constitute fixed essences; climatic hierarchies are contingent and reversible. It is one thing to claim that a group is biologically inferior, and quite another to argue that particular environmental conditions constrain a group’s potential and limit its ability to produce

在伊本·赫勒敦看来，这些状况表明气候对人类社会施加的限制，而非生物决定论。生物学等级构成固定本质，气候等级则取决于条件且可以逆转。宣称某个群体在生物学上低劣是一回事，主张特定环境条件约束某个群体的潜能、限制其产生ʿumrân的能力，则是另一回事；这里的ʿumrân被理解为技艺、科学和等级的发展。此外，ʿumrân本身似乎也并非伊本·赫勒敦最偏爱的状态。他往往更欣赏badâwa状态，赞赏其质朴、韧性（tawaḥḥush）及其伦理气质。

This expression is usually translated as “dumb animals,” whereas a closer rendering would be beings lacking articulate speech in an Aristotelian sense, not a racial category. The expression in Arabic also sounds like a pleonasm. “Closer” indicates a relational frame, a matter of degree within forms of sociality, language use, and crafts. It is not a permanent or essentialist trait. To say “similar,” as in Rosenthal’s translation, is to emphasize resemblance in traits or behavior; it is more static and lends itself to a biologically deterministic reading. Taken together, these distinctions show that Ibn Khaldûn grounds human difference in modes of settlement rather than in biological or racial distinction.
zh: Insâniya源于ʿuns（交往性），后者与孤立相反；因此它是一种有益品质，促进团结与合作，而这两者对ʿumrân的发展都至关重要。
相比之下，tawaḥḥush似乎是insâniya的反面。如果ʿuns及insâniya是交往性，那么tawaḥḥush便是分散、孤立以及交往性的缺失或极低程度。更具体地说，具有tawaḥḥush这一品质，意味着“更接近”（qarība）——而非法译本和英译本中的“相似”——伊本·赫勒敦所说的al-ḥayawânât al-ʿujm。

这一表达通常被译作“不会说话的动物”（dumb animals），而更贴近的译法应是亚里士多德意义上缺乏清晰言语的生物，并非种族范畴。这一阿拉伯语表达听上去也像同义赘述。“更接近”表示一种关系框架，是社会性形式、语言使用和技艺之中的程度问题，而非永久性或本质主义特征。像罗森塔尔的译本那样说“相似”，则强调特征或行为上的相像，更加静态，也容易引向生物决定论式的解读。综合这些区别可以看出，伊本·赫勒敦将人类差异奠基于聚居方式，而非生物或种族区分。

zh: 不过，伊本·赫勒敦并不认为任何单一群体——甚至他自己的阿拉伯人群体——优于其他群体。在其文本中，阿拉伯人也被以类似其他人的方式描述，包括指出他们中的某些人具有tawaḥḥush且缺少ʿumrân。他认为埃及人与生活在炎热气候中的黑人相似，也更易欢乐、激动。在阿拉伯部落之间，他用ʿaṣabiyya、ḥasab和nasab解释地位不平等。伊本·赫勒敦还使用另外两个重要范畴：力量（shawkat）和支配（ghalaba），尤其是在试图理解部落如何成为王朝时。在他看来，没有什么是永久的，一切都会变化。有些人通过ʿaṣabiyya、ḥasab与nasab积累力量，取得支配地位，日益扩大其支配，随后又逐渐失去它。有些人从未获得任何支配地位，只能承受他人的支配；这并非由于某种有缺陷的生物品质，而是因为气候与环境未能给予他们有利条件，而且他们未能满足ʿaṣabiyya那些颇具偶然性的条件：宗教，或更确切地说宗教使命（daʿwa dîniya）；部落规模或成员数量（ʿadad）；以及高贵地位（ḥasab）。

en: One may well argue that Ibn Khaldûn creates a hierarchy of geography, and thus ipso facto classifies what seems like a hierarchy of race. The problem with this argument is that a variety of peoples, not just Blacks, are favored by the climate, even as, at the same time, a variety of people, including Blacks, are disfavored by it. The problem with racial thinking, by contrast, is that one group is considered superior to all others, regardless of climate or geography (i.e., whites in eighteenth- and nineteenth-century racial theories);

other groups are considered racially inferior, with Blacks seen as the most inferior of all, regardless of climate or environment. The differences are biological and irreversible. In racial thinking, the world is racially hierarchical, and its hierarchy is both natural and permanent. Moreover, “this prejudice,” as Lewis Gordon put it in his discussion of W. E. B. Du Bois, “centred the categories of universal man in terms of particularities that excluded racialized people and related ethnic typographies, with the result that a particular kind of man became the presumption of man.”
zh: 人们完全可以主张，伊本·赫勒敦创造了一种地理等级，从而事实上划分出一种看似种族等级的东西。这一论点的问题在于，受到气候眷顾的是多种人群，而不只是黑人；与此同时，受到气候不利影响的也包括多种人群，黑人亦在其中。相比之下，种族思维的问题在于，它把某一群体视为优于所有其他群体，不论气候或地理如何——例如18和19世纪种族理论中的白人；
其他群体则被视为种族上低劣，而黑人被视为其中最劣等者，同样不论气候或环境如何。差异是生物性的，也是不可逆转的。在种族思维中，世界按种族划分等级，而其等级既是自然的，也是永久的。此外，正如刘易斯·戈登在讨论W. E. B. 杜波依斯时所说：“这种偏见”以排除被种族化人群及相关族群类型的特殊性为依据，来确立普遍人的范畴，结果是“某一种特定的人，成为关于人的预设”。

en: This is clearly not the perspective of Ibn Khaldûn. He does not make any one people the standard of humanity. His medieval worldview was more religiously centered than ethnocentric. Yet, although Ibn Khaldûn lived in a Muslim society and apparently espoused its ideology as both a believer and a subject, his work constitutes a rationalist investigation, clearly independent of and distinct from the theological framework of its time.
